### `GET /nodes/{node}/capabilities/qemu/cpu-flags`

```ts
proxmox.nodes.$(node).capabilities.qemu["cpu-flags"].$get()
```

List of available VM-specific CPU flags. Returns an empty list for 'aarch64' as no VM-specific flags are defined for it yet.

Returns an array of `object`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accel` | `kvm` \| `tcg` |  | Acceleration type to check node compatibility for. — default `"kvm"` |
| `arch` | `x86_64` \| `aarch64` |  | Virtual processor architecture. Defaults to the host architecture. |
| `node` | string | yes | The cluster node name. — format `pve-node` |

### `GET /nodes/{node}/capabilities/qemu/migration`

```ts
proxmox.nodes.$(node).capabilities.qemu.migration.$get()
```

Get node-specific QEMU migration capabilities of the node. Requires the 'Sys.Audit' permission on '/nodes/&lt;node&gt;'.

Returns `object`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `node` | string | yes | The cluster node name. — format `pve-node` |
